title: A worked example with the ChrAccR example data
text: annotation comes methylTFRAnnotationHg38, unchanged methylTFR. prepareTFBS() resizes binding sites footprint window; everything downstream works object. expected profile GC model : insertion density sample summarised per GC bin, combined GC composition binding sites. accFootprintData() stacks insertions centre every binding site returns observed expected curves groups. deviation score reads curve one number, insertion density central window density outer flanks, minus ratio expected curve. value zero means centre protected sequence composition predicts.  CTCF control look first: binds stably, footprint deep corrected curve dips well one. AP-1 opposite case, factor short residence time whose footprint stays shallow even active.
code: motifs <- c("CTCF", "FOS::JUN") tf_bindsites <- methylTFRAnnotationHg38::getTFbindsites(     motifSet = "jaspar2020" ) gcfreqs <- methylTFRAnnotationHg38::getGCfreq(motifSet = "jaspar2020") gc_dist <- methylTFRAnnotationHg38::getGenomeGC()  tfbs <- lapply(motifs, function(m) prepareTFBS(tf_bindsites[[m]])) names(tfbs) <- motifs lengths(tfbs) #>     CTCF FOS::JUN  #>   554572   244961 binIns <- lapply(ins, addGCBintoAccessome, gcdist = gc_dist) expected <- lapply(groups, function(g) {     prof <- lapply(motifs, function(m) {         computeAccExpectations(binIns[[g]], gcfreqs[[m]])     })     names(prof) <- motifs     prof }) names(expected) <- groups profiles <- lapply(motifs, function(m) {     e <- lapply(groups, function(g) expected[[g]][[m]])     names(e) <- groups     accFootprintData(tfbs[[m]], ins, e) }) names(profiles) <- motifs head(profiles[["CTCF"]]) #>        x      avg_ins     type     group #>    <num>        <num>   <char>    <fctr> #> 1:  -272 0.0003567070 Observed TCD8naive #> 2:  -271 0.0003552325 Observed TCD8naive #> 3:  -270 0.0003511040 Observed TCD8naive #> 4:  -269 0.0003618358 Observed TCD8naive #> 5:  -268 0.0003618812 Observed TCD8naive #> 6:  -267 0.0003682324 Observed TCD8naive vapply(profiles, function(df) {     df[group == "TCD8naive", accDeviation(.SD),         .SDcols = c("x", "avg_ins", "type")] }, numeric(1)) #>       CTCF   FOS::JUN  #> 0.01605233 0.57030763 colours <- c(TCD8naive = "#3B6EA5", TCD8EM = "#B23A48") plotAccFootprintGrid(profiles, tfbs, colours, corrected = "GC corrected") #> INFO [2026-09-28 22:55:49] CTCF, GC corrected deviations: TCD8naive = 0.016, TCD8EM = -0.021 #> INFO [2026-09-28 22:55:49] FOS::JUN, GC corrected deviations: TCD8naive = 0.57, TCD8EM = 1.496

title: A worked example with the ChrAccR example data
text: Tn5 prefers short sequences others, motif fixed string letters centre every window, part dip chemistry rather protein. computeKmerBias() measures preference cuts kmerBiasProfile() turns expected curve. needs genome sequence. Comparing two models motif honest check: dip survives k-mer correction footprint, one flattens Tn5 preferring flanking sequence.
code: library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38) genome <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38  bg <- kmerBackground(peaks, genome, k = 6L) bias <- lapply(ins, computeKmerBias,     regions = peaks, genome = genome, k = 6L, bg = bg ) expectedK <- lapply(groups, function(g) {     prof <- lapply(motifs, function(m) {         kmerBiasProfile(tfbs[[m]], genome, bias[[g]], k = 6L)     })     names(prof) <- motifs     prof }) names(expectedK) <- groups

title: Transcription factor footprints in chromatin accessibility data
text: chromTFR chromatin accessibility counterpart methylTFR. uses annotation, methylation levels replaced Tn5 insertion densities: every binding site motif insertions counted per base, sites stacked centre average gives footprint. protein bound motif shields DNA Tn5, profile dips centre rises flanks. deviation score shape one number, insertion density central window density outer flanks, corrected ratio computed expected profile.

title: Transcription factor footprints in chromatin accessibility data
text: Two models available. GC model follows methylTFR: genome wide insertion density summarised per GC bin addGCBintoAccessome() combined GC bin composition binding sites computeAccExpectations(). k-mer model captures sequence preference Tn5 directly. computeKmerBias() counts k-mer centred every observed cut compares frequency k-mer accessible genome, kmerBiasProfile() averages weights along binding sites. motif fixed string letters centre every window, term matters: -rich motif Tn5 cuts less centre chemical reasons alone, looks like protection.

title: Transcription factor footprints in chromatin accessibility data
text: runChromTFR() runs GC based workflow every sample motif returns SummarizedExperiment deviations, row-wise z-scores expected deviations.
code: library(chromTFR)  dsa <- loadAccDataset("dsATAC_filtered") peaks <- getAccRegions(dsa, regionType = ".peaks.cons", extend = 500) ins <- getTn5Insertions(dsa, getAccSamples(dsa)[1], regions = peaks)  tfbs <- prepareTFBS(tf_bindsites[["CTCF"]]) profile <- accProfile(ins, tfbs) accDeviationScore(profile)

title: Transcription factor footprints in chromatin accessibility data
text: accFootprintData() builds observed expected curves one motif named list samples group aggregates, plotAccFootprintGrid() draws two rows, profiles top corrected curves , labelled deviation score. per sample overview, accObservedMatrix() accExpectedMatrix() give two halves deviation matrix plotAccDeviationHeatmap() draws row-wise z-scores. Fit Tn5 model per sample : one shared model expected term constant per motif cancels row-wise z-score.

title: Transcription factor footprints in chromatin accessibility data
text: deviation score footprint depth: insertion density central window density outer flanks. chromVAR measures different quantity, accessibility peaks carry motif, corresponds flanking accessibility rather depth footprint. two separate axes picture (Baek et al. 2017; Corces et al. 2018, Fig. 4), motif can move one . heatmap scores expected reproduce chromVAR heatmap, sign opposite: deeper footprint, meaning protection, gives lower score.

what: chromTFR: Quantification of Chromatin Accessibility Signatures in TFBS — chromTFR-package
title: chromTFR: Quantification of Chromatin Accessibility Signatures in TFBS — chromTFR-package
text: chromTFR quantifies transcription factor footprints chromatin accessibility data using annotation methylTFR package. Tn5 insertion densities replace methylation levels, expected profile motif derived either GC bin composition binding sites k-mer model Tn5 sequence preference. package computes bias corrected deviation scores per sample motif, draws underlying footprints summarises deviations heatmap.
